Now I have everything I need. Here's the full coverage analysis:

---

## Test Coverage Gap Analysis

### Files with no test file at all

| File | Gap severity |
|------|-------------|
| `security/policy-engine.ts` | Critical — core security decision path |
| `session/brain.ts` | High — session persistence/recovery |
| `session/plan.ts` | High — plan CRUD is exercised via commands |
| `orchestration/scheduler.ts` | High — timer logic is easy to mistest |
| `safeguards/diff.ts` | Medium — diff output feeds the approval gate UI |
| `bootstrap/validate.ts` | Medium — startup warnings are silent if broken |
| `session/stats.ts` | Low — pure accumulator, but formatting logic can drift |
| `mcp/credentials.ts` | Medium — encrypt/decrypt round-trip and expiry logic |
| `adapters/cache.ts` | Trivial — singleton, 2 tests cover it |
| `codemap/summarizer.ts` | Medium — Flash fallback path is untested |

### Coverage gaps inside existing test files

| Test file | What's missing |
|-----------|----------------|
| `tests/adapters/stream.ts` | `validateMessageOrder` violation path; fallback manual chunk merge branch |
| `tests/events/bus.ts` | `registerEvent` / `listRegisteredEvents` never called |
| `tests/bootstrap/cleanup.ts` | `isProcessAlive` with EPERM (process exists but signal denied) |
| `tests/config/loader.ts` | `deepMerge` with nested arrays; `resolveApiKeys` missing-env warning |
| `tests/mcp/engine.ts` | `setSamplingHandler` / `setElicitationHandler` invocation; tool call passthrough |
| `tests/session/context.ts` | `clearFocusedFiles`; token eviction that removes the least-recently-used pair |

### Integration test gaps

`tests/integration/flows.test.ts` hits `directChat`, `runGoal`, `routeMCPToolCall`, and `checkpoint` but only one "happy path" each. Missing:
- Tool call loop that requires approval and is denied mid-turn
- Escalation that actually switches model tier
- Goal loop that hits turn budget and aborts
- MCP tool routed to a disconnected server (error pro
